title: Insert div between hit results
body:
Hi, am developing a project using php and instantsearch.js

I'd like to be able to insert a div after every 4 hits that contains an image.  I'm not sure where to start with this but could someone post some sample code ?
I believe it can be achieved using the RenderHandler.

Any help appreciated.

Thanks in advance.  Guy

comments.body:
Here's an example doing so: https://jsfiddle.net/vvoyer/cgaoppoe/1/

Let me know if that's sufficient.
Hi, that's fantastic.  Thanks v much !

You cannot use it while using the regular hits widget, you will have to use the code I gave you on jsFiddle and work on it using jQuery.

If this is too much of a struggle then I would advise you to ask for general coding help on http://stackoverflow.com/.

RIght now the example is showing you how to implement it using instantsearch.js, if you have more code question StackOverflow is the place to ask them. Thanks!
No worries, I've implemented your solution, thanks v much.
